newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 16.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 16.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Wednesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.

New Tropical Storm Felicia had intensified, and was spotted at about 402 miles/643 km south-southwest of the Socorro Island in the Pacific. The storm was moving west-northwest at 9 knots (10 miles/17 km), and expected to strengthen while moving away from Mexico's Pacific coastline.

Enrique, now downgraded to a tropical depression, was spotted approximately 1100 miles/1469 km west-southwest of Ensenada, Baja California. It was continuing to move west-northwest and losing steam, the ministry said.
Electric storms and strong winds were reported in Oaxaca, Chiapas, Jalisco and Nayarit. Strong rains and storms also in Guerrero, Colima and Michoacan states.
